_notes: Compatibility scores (0-1) are literature-informed judgement calls made for this prototype, not measured plant data. Sources discussed in chat: MDPI 'Sustainable Valorization of Waste and By-Products from Sugarcane Processing' (sugar ratios), Indian Bureau of Mines 'Slag - Iron and Steel' Yearbook chapter (steel ratios), CEA CO2 Baseline Database (grid emission factor), UK Govt GHG Conversion Factors (freight emission factor). Cement-side ratios (fly ash, bottom ash) are round-number placeholders pending a literature pass before the final review - flagged here on purpose so the team doesn't forget.

materials.name: Bagasse
materials.description: Fibrous residue left after crushing sugarcane to extract juice.
materials.typical_ratio: ~280-300 kg wet bagasse (≈50% moisture) per tonne of sugarcane crushed

materials.name: Press Mud (Filter Cake)
materials.description: Sludge/filter cake left after clarifying sugarcane juice, rich in organic matter.
materials.typical_ratio: ~30 kg wet press mud per tonne of sugarcane crushed

compatible_industries.reuse_type: minor raw-mix organic additive (low volume use)

materials.name: Molasses
materials.description: Viscous by-product of sugar crystallization, high sugar content.
materials.typical_ratio: ~41 kg molasses per tonne of sugarcane crushed

materials.name: Bagasse Ash
materials.description: Ash residue from burning bagasse in cogeneration boilers.
materials.typical_ratio: ~8-10 kg ash per tonne of bagasse burned

materials.name: Blast Furnace Slag
materials.description: Molten by-product from iron-making in the blast furnace, granulated for reuse.
materials.typical_ratio: ~250-300 kg per tonne of hot metal (BF/BOF route)

materials.name: Steel Slag
materials.description: By-product of the steel-making (converter/EAF) stage, distinct from blast furnace slag.
materials.typical_ratio: ~100-150 kg per tonne of crude steel

materials.name: Mill Scale
materials.description: Flaky iron-oxide by-product formed during hot rolling.
materials.typical_ratio: ~20-30 kg per tonne of rolled steel

materials.name: Fly Ash
materials.description: Fine particulate by-product captured from coal-fired power plant flue gas.
materials.typical_ratio: ~100-150 kg per tonne of coal burned (placeholder pending literature pass)

materials.name: Bottom Ash
materials.description: Coarser ash residue collected at the base of the coal furnace.
materials.typical_ratio: ~15-25 kg per tonne of coal burned (placeholder pending literature pass)
